subject: SOC 2 re-attestation for renewal + retention extension & capacity top-up
messages:

Cc: procurement@novusfinance.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal / SOC2 re-attestation question + retention request

Hi Mina,

We're starting our vendor renewal conversation for Novus (deal id NVS-2027-183). Procurement asked I loop you in: we need Redwood's plans for SOC 2 re-attestation as part of the renewal. Two asks from our side:

1) Retention: would it be possible to extend audit log retention for our account to 24 months (currently 12)? We need this for our internal compliance.
2) Capacity: expected traffic next year is trending up. We'd like to discuss a +25% throughput/capacity top-up and how that maps to pricing and lead times.

I've attached our standard procurement form. Can you confirm what evidence you'll need for the SOC 2 recert and an estimated timeline so we can align internal audit?

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Senior IT Compliance Manager, Novus Finance
elena@novusfinance.com

Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal / SOC2 re-attestation question + retention request

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the procurement form. Appreciate the clear asks. High-level plan below; I'll follow up with a concrete timeline and attachments.

Summary plan (short):
- SOC 2 re-attestation: we can run a targeted evidence sprint aligned to your audit window. Typical turnaround from kickoff to handoff is 4–6 weeks for the artifacts we control.
- Retention: we can extend audit-log retention to 24 months for Novus; this requires a short addendum (billing impact noted below).
- Capacity top-up: +25% throughput can be provisioned; we'll propose a 3-month onramp with a reserved burst buffer.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Security kickoff call (1 hour) this week — Kimberly will scope exact artifact list and export specs.
2) We provide an evidence handoff template and artifact inventory (attached).
3) We send a renewal addendum draft (term + retention + seat/throughput pricing) for your legal review; include your PO details and DocuSign link when ready.

Pricing note (estimate): +24mo retention addendum = $1,200/mo (data carriers & extended storage); +25% capacity top-up (reserved) = one-time onboarding fee $3,000 + $X/month over base usage (we'll provide a precise figure after we baseline usage).

I've attached the SOC2 artifact list and an evidence-onramp template so your audit team can preview what we'll request. Kimberly, can you add the export details and any egress notes? Marissa / Karthik — I'll need help with pricing and commercial redlines.

Availability: I'm open Thu 10–12 or Fri 09–11 PT for the kickoff.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Account Director, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal / SOC2 re-attestation question + retention request

Elena / Mina — adding a few technical constraints and what we'll need from Novus to keep the evidence sprint efficient.

What Redwood will provide (typical):
- Artifact inventory: configs, IAM snapshots, policy exports, ingestion/kafka pipeline SLOs, sample tokens (redacted), key rotation evidence.
- System logs export: auth logs, admin audit events, model inference request metadata (timestamps, route, model version), billing/usage aggregates.

What we need from Novus:
- Point of contact for your audit team and log retention owner.
- If you require PII redaction, please confirm the redaction rules; we can apply on-export masking but will note it in the evidence.

Export specs and constraints:
- Exports are delivered as compressed CSV/NDJSON bundles. Max export window per job is 90 days; for 24 months we'll run a 8-job parallelized export plan (staggered). Expect each job to take 4–8 hours depending on event volume.
- Egress costs: large historical exports may incur an egress surcharge; I'll include a rough estimate after we baseline Novus volume.

I'll attach the log export spec doc; Mina, Marissa — this also feeds into the implementation timeline.

Kimberly Park
Director, Platform Security, Redwood Inference

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa to finalize the commercial paperwork and Karthik to queue the onramp engineering tasks.
